These files were generated by us. The `.emf` files are GDI+ drawings of synthetic content recorded with `System.Drawing.Imaging.Metafile`,
once as EMF+ only (`_plusonly`) and once as EMF+ dual (`_dual`, which also carries the GDI records). The `_gdiplus_*.png` files are what
GDI+ rendered for each (`Graphics.DrawImage` of the metafile into a white 32-bit bitmap of the given size, the whole picture frame
stretched over it). They contain no third-party content. The machine is the one described in `../oracle/display.txt` (Windows 11, 150%
display scaling). `g_pageunits` is missing: GDI+ refused to record it ("Parameter is not valid").
The renderer is compared with them by `WindowsGdiPlusReferenceTests`.
